pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Actually inspected960×619 southwest facade:open ground-floor round/pointed arcade,alternating pale/red voussoirs,pale geometric parapet screens,rectangular lower windows beneath pointed surrounds and round upper lunettes. Tall fluted stone minaret and rectangular buttress piers with small capped turrets. Fine screens,carvings and current finish remain unverified. This is a close view,not sufficient overall silhouette evidence.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Actually inspected960×630 courtyard view toward southeast hall:dominant shallow grey lead dome on windowed drum,large paired octagonal grey capped turrets on stepped stone supports,small dome above monumental entrance portal and two visible minarets with pointed grey cones and decorative balcony collars. Alternating dark red/pale entrance arch and pale carved panels. Fine inscriptions are reference only,not to be copied.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Actually inspected960×621 northeast facade:grey central drum/dome with capped octagonal supports,stepped side roofs and pale arched tympanum with grouped windows. Two-tier side wall/open lower arcade,paired rectangular/arched window fields above,alternating red/pale arch surrounds and open patterned parapet screens. Several pale buttress piers and small corner caps. Overall tower and rear silhouette still needs a wider picture.

pictures.author: eye of einstein
pictures.observed: Actually inspected500×644 overall exterior:single broad shallow grey dome and window band on stepped octagonal supports,small grey capped buttress turrets,four tall slender stone minarets each with three projecting collars and pointed grey cones. Low domed striped-arch courtyard enclosure in foreground;separate surrounding buildings remain host content. Perspective changes apparent tower heights;no survey of geometry or current finish.
